source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: If you are under eighteen taking the written test, your application must be signed and approved by a parent, court appointed guardian, county appointed foster parent, or director of the transitional living program where you live with documentation if the signer is not a parent, and if completed you bring the Supplemental Parental Curriculum completion certificate.
corrections.note: Added the missing if completed condition for the certificate.

corrections.corrected_statement: When you see a stopped school bus with flashing red lights you must stop your vehicle at least twenty feet from the bus and the only exception is when you are traveling in the opposite direction on a divided highway.
corrections.note: Removed the behind or beside positions and added the twenty feet distance.

corrections.corrected_statement: A teen must be at least 15 years old for the written test, a different age from the road test minimum on the next checklist page.
A teen must be at least 16 years old for the road test and brings the White Card, which certifies completed driver education, rather than the Blue or Pink enrollment card.
You will not be able to get your Minnesota drivers license until you present all other drivers licenses and identification cards to D V S.
corrections.note: Changed hand in to present to match the page wording.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you fail two consecutive written tests, a ten dollar fee is charged for the third and any subsequent tests.
corrections.note: Removed road test comparison that is not stated on this page.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you fail the road test two times, a twenty dollar retest fee will be charged for each subsequent test.
corrections.note: Removed double the written fee comparison not stated on this page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Farm work and special medical applicants skip the six-month wait before the road test but still need a permit, a behind-the-wheel completion certificate and a supervised driving log.
corrections.note: The identical medical rule is printed on page 20, not page 19.

corrections.corrected_statement: The No Passing Zone warning sign is on the left side of a two way highway and warns of the beginning of a no passing zone.
corrections.note: Removed the unmentioned Do Not Pass sign and kept only the left side warning sign.

corrections.corrected_statement: The interlock blocks starting at 0.02 percent, which is lower than both the 0.04 commercial limit and the 0.08 general limit.

School buses use yellow and red lights that flash alternately to warn drivers they are stopping, with yellow lights activated at least one hundred feet before stopping in zones of thirty five miles per hour or less and at least three hundred feet before stopping in faster zones.
corrections.note: Added missing at least and alternately and corrected distances to minimums.

corrections.corrected_statement: A driver who passes a stopped school bus faces a misdemeanor, while the vehicle's owner or lessee faces a petty misdemeanor unless they show someone else was driving.
corrections.note: Driver misdemeanor penalty is stated on page 45, not page 46.
